metadata.title: Town of Morristown Fair Tax Burden & Equalization Engine

fairnessDiagnosis.summary: Why property taxes in Town of Morristown have shifted heavily onto residential homeowners, and how balanced commercial ratables and 50% PILOT sharing can cut tax bills while keeping schools 100% funded.

coreInequities.title: PILOT Agreements Exclude Morris School District (Regional K-12) (54.8% of Tax Rate)
coreInequities.description: Schools represent 54.8% of property taxes in Town of Morristown, but 30-year PILOTs send 95% of fees to Town Hall and $0 to classrooms.
coreInequities.remedy: Codify a binding municipal ordinance dedicating 50% of PILOT revenues directly to public schools.

coreInequities.title: Homeowners Shoulder 56.4% of the Tax Base
coreInequities.description: Commercial ratables have eroded over 20 years, forcing single-family families to absorb larger shares of municipal and school budgets.
coreInequities.remedy: Incentivize commercial redevelopment to restore commercial share back toward 35%.

presetScenarios.name: Status Quo Baseline (2026 Town of Morristown)
presetScenarios.summary: Current certified tax distribution in Town of Morristown. Homeowners fund 56.4% of the budget.
presetScenarios.winners: Commercial developers with long-term PILOT abatements.
presetScenarios.losers: Town of Morristown single-family homeowners and public school students.

presetScenarios.name: The Town of Morristown Unified Fair Tax Blueprint
presetScenarios.summary: Dedicating 50% of PILOTs to schools, restoring commercial ratables, and capping senior burdens saves the average Town of Morristown homeowner ~$1,950/yr.
presetScenarios.winners: 90%+ of Town of Morristown homeowners, public schools, and fixed-income seniors.
presetScenarios.losers: Speculative developers seeking 30-year school-exempt tax abatements.

sampleHomeProfiles.label: Typical Town of Morristown Single-Family Home

policyRoadmap.title: Enact 50% PILOT Revenue-Sharing with Morris School District (Regional K-12)
policyRoadmap.action: Codify a mandatory municipal ordinance transferring half of all PILOT fees to the school district.
policyRoadmap.outcome: Saves Town of Morristown homeowners millions in school tax subsidies.

policyRoadmap.title: Commercial Ratable Corridor Revitalization
policyRoadmap.action: Attract high-value biotech, retail, and corporate ratables to relieve single-family homeowners.
policyRoadmap.outcome: Restores commercial ratable share toward 35% in Town of Morristown.
